title: Entity-Switched Datasets: An Approach to Auditing the In-Domain Robustness of Named Entity Recognition Models

bias_targets.methodology: Creating entity-switched datasets by programmatically replacing original named entities (e.g., person names, locations, organizations) in standard NER datasets with plausible entities from 15 different countries of origin, and measuring the performance degradation (F1, precision, recall) of Named Entity Recognition models.

Substituting person names in texts with names strongly associated with specific ethnic groups (e.g., African American and Native American names) to evaluate robustness and disparities in named entity recognition.
